text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Tunisia on Wednesday celebrated the Associations Day. President Ben Ali said he was encouraging associations activities to play a role in development.
- Works at the Barbra barrage for a capacity of 800,000 cubic metres in Northwestern Tunisia expected to be finished by March 1998.
- Tunisia will celebrate on Friday The Security Forces and Customs Day.
- Tourism and Handicrafts Minister Slaheddine Maaoui received on Tuesday Saudi businessmen who invested in the touristic complex "Montazah des cotes de Carthage", near Tunis.
